blocks.text: James’ experience as a lawyer and mediator provide him with the necessary skills to take charge of difficult clients dealing with addiction problems. In addition to his legal degree, James has a Masters of Arts in Conflict Analysis and Management. He is the Associate Director of the Lawyers Assistance Program of British Columbia, and has extensive experience working with professionals such as lawyers, judges and doctors with addiction or emotional problems.

blocks.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747

centre.about_html:
About Center

James’ experience as a lawyer and mediator provide him with the necessary skills to take charge of difficult clients dealing with addiction problems. In addition to his legal degree, James has a Masters of Arts in Conflict Analysis and Management. He is the Associate Director of the Lawyers Assistance Program of British Columbia, and has extensive experience working with professionals such as lawyers, judges and doctors with addiction or emotional problems.
